name: Banana
personality: Easygoing crowd-pleaser who bends to avoid conflict.
character: Flexible and a little slippery; always 'a-peeling' to everyone.
cheating: Doesn't chase it — slips into an affair because he can't say no.
properties: Bends without breaking; thin skin; bruises show instantly; comes in a bunch.
growth: Green and stiff — shy, weak, easily overlooked, terrified of standing out.
prime: Golden and bulky — confident and magnetic, doing all the reckless things he hated as a kid.
ripening: Brown spots spread — friends betray him and his sweetness curdles into self-loathing.
senescence: Blackened and mushy — collapses into regret, blaming the bunch that left him.

name: Apple
personality: Wholesome on the surface, dangerously tempting underneath.
character: 'One bad apple' — polished skin, a worm of a secret at the core.
cheating: The forbidden-fruit affair; seduces the one person who is strictly off-limits.
properties: Shiny waxed skin; a hidden worm; keeps the doctor away but never the drama.
growth: Tiny and tart — innocent, sun-chasing, desperate to be picked.
prime: Crisp and flawless — the object everyone wants, weaponizing her desirability.
ripening: Skin wrinkles and bruises brown — the worm surfaces; her reputation rots from the inside.
senescence: Soft and sunken — mealy and forgotten in the bowl, bitter about being passed over.

name: Orange
personality: Bright, bubbly, the life of every gathering.
character: Thick peel over a segmented heart she shares with everyone and no one.
cheating: Emotional affairs — splits her heart into segments and gives one to each.
properties: Zesty; protective rind; divides neatly so nobody ever gets the whole.
growth: Green and sour — naive, trying far too hard to be sweet.
prime: Vibrant and juicy — the radiant socialite, everyone's 'favorite person'.
ripening: Peel loosens and pith shows — the segments don't add up; people feel used.
senescence: Dry and hollow — all rind, no juice; the party moved on without her.

name: Strawberry
personality: Glamorous and romantic; wears her heart, and her seeds, on the outside.
character: Seeds on the skin — every secret is visible; she can't hide a thing.
cheating: The love-triangle temptress who ignites jealousy just by existing.
properties: Red and irresistible; bruises and molds fast; heart worn externally.
growth: White and hard — insecure, aching to be noticed and finally turn red.
prime: Deep red and dressed to kill — the temptress who starts every love triangle.
ripening: Soft spots and first mold — her exposed secrets destroy her as scandal spreads.
senescence: Mushy and gray-furred — a spoiled reputation, discarded from the carton.

name: Grape
personality: Never alone — moves as a bunch and manipulates from the middle.
character: Comes with a crew; turns sweet to sour when crossed; ferments grudges.
cheating: Cheats to climb — trades partners for power within the bunch.
properties: Travels in bunches; ferments into wine to loosen tongues; 'sour grapes' when bitter.
growth: Tiny and green — a hanger-on, desperate to matter to the vine.
prime: Plump and purple — kingpin of the bunch, and everyone owes him.
ripening: Wrinkling toward raisin — the crew defects and his bitterness ferments into revenge.
senescence: A shriveled raisin — a has-been muttering about the old vine, all alone.

name: Watermelon
personality: Big, loud, all bravado — and ninety percent water underneath.
character: Tough green rind over a shockingly soft red heart; spits secrets like seeds.
cheating: The drunken one-time slip he confesses immediately — he can't keep it in.
properties: Massive; hard rind, tender core; sounds hollow; full of seeds to spit.
growth: Small and pale — a soft kid hiding behind a tough act.
prime: Enormous and sweet — the intimidating giant with a marshmallow heart.
ripening: Overripe and mealy — cracks under pressure and spills everyone's secrets.
senescence: Collapsed and fermenting — a burst mess nobody wants to clean up.

name: Pineapple
personality: Prickly and regal — wears a crown and knows it.
character: An armor of spikes with golden sweetness reserved only for the worthy.
cheating: Cheats 'down' then denies it — too proud to admit slumming it.
properties: Spiky armor; wears a crown; sweet-tart; genuinely hard to get into.
growth: All spikes, no sweetness — a guarded, defensive upstart.
prime: Golden and crowned — the untouchable aristocrat everyone courts.
ripening: Browning crown and fermenting core — the noble mask slips into scandal.
senescence: Rotten and sunken-crowned — dethroned and sour, clinging to old titles.

name: Peach
personality: Soft, warm, impossibly desirable — with a stone where her heart should be.
character: Fuzzy and tender outside; a hard pit inside that no one can crack.
cheating: Serial heartbreaker — lets many get close, lets no one in.
properties: Velvet skin; bruises at a touch; a hard stone core; 'peachy' on the surface.
growth: Small and green, fuzz too big for her — awkward, guarded, tender.
prime: Blushing and ripe — the femme fatale everyone falls for.
ripening: Bruises bloom and flesh softens — the hearts she broke return for revenge.
senescence: Wrinkled around the pit — alone with the stone she never let anyone touch.

name: Cherry
personality: Playful and paired; thrives on being wanted.
character: Always on a stem beside another — her loyalty is negotiable.
cheating: A two-timer by nature — literally comes as a pair and dates both.
properties: Comes in twos; bright red; a hard pit; stains whatever she touches.
growth: Pale and sour — clingy, needing a 'twin' to feel whole.
prime: A glossy red pair — the flirt at the center of every 'who's with who'.
ripening: Split skin and exposed pit — the double life unravels in public.
senescence: Shriveled on the stem — abandoned by both, staining her own name.

name: Lemon
personality: Sharp-tongued and sour; sees the acid in everything.
character: Zesty wit that curdles milk; nobody's fool, everybody's critic.
cheating: Revenge cheating — 'you hurt me, so I'll make it sting'.
properties: Sour and acidic; bright zest; preserves grudges; 'when life gives lemons'.
growth: Hard and green — a wary, prickly kid expecting betrayal.
prime: Bright and zesty — the sharp cynic whose burns everyone quotes.
ripening: Skin toughens and juice dries — bitterness alienates the few who stayed.
senescence: Dried and rock-hard — a preserved lemon, all rind and old grudges.

name: Lime
personality: Lemon's cooler, sharper cousin — loyal but loves chaos.
character: Small and potent; the friend who dares you into trouble.
cheating: The wingman who 'accidentally' ends up with the target himself.
properties: Smaller, sharper, greener; the kick in every cocktail; loosens inhibitions.
growth: Tiny and sour — the overlooked sidekick craving the spotlight.
prime: Sharp and vivid — the enabler at the heart of every party.
ripening: Yellowing and softening — the schemes backfire as friends wise up.
senescence: Hard and dried — a bitter has-been who 'made' everyone and is thanked by none.

name: Blueberry
personality: Sweet and humble, quietly perfect — and a little smug about it.
character: Small but a 'superfood'; flaunts virtue and hides ego.
cheating: Micro-cheating she swears 'didn't mean anything', all while morally superior.
properties: Tiny; antioxidant 'superfood'; stains everything blue; travels in punnets.
growth: Green and tart — a try-hard good kid fishing for praise.
prime: Plump and perfect — the wholesome darling everyone trusts.
ripening: Soft and leaking — the halo slips and the stains won't wash out.
senescence: Moldy in the punnet — sanctimony curdled, trusted by no one.

name: Raspberry
personality: Fragile and theatrical; falls apart at a touch.
character: A hollow core; intricate, high-maintenance, easily crushed.
cheating: The emotional-affair martyr with 'you drove me to it' tears.
properties: Hollow center; crushes instantly; molds overnight; costly and delicate.
growth: Hard and pale — anxious, fragile, over-sensitive.
prime: Jewel-red and delicate — the drama queen everyone tiptoes around.
ripening: Collapsing and weeping juice — the meltdowns push everyone away.
senescence: Furred and sunken — a cautionary tale about being too fragile to love.

name: Blackberry
personality: Dark, thorny, mysterious — trouble with a soft center.
character: Guarded by thorns; deep and complex; stains whatever he touches.
cheating: The brooding serial charmer who 'warned you he was bad'.
properties: Thorned canes; deep purple-black; stains; grows wild and invasive.
growth: Red and hard (unripe) — an angry, thorny outsider.
prime: Black and glossy — the magnetic bad boy everyone's been warned about.
ripening: Overripe and bleeding — the wildness turns self-destructive.
senescence: Dried on the bramble — a cautionary legend, all thorns and no fruit.

name: Pear
personality: Refined and patient, quietly superior about good breeding.
character: Ripens from the inside out — rots at the core before anyone notices.
cheating: The respectable long-game affair; decades of quiet betrayal.

growth: Hard and green — a stiff, proper, sheltered heir.
prime: Elegant and buttery — the very picture of tasteful respectability.
ripening: Mushy at the core while the skin still looks fine — hidden rot exposed.
senescence: Brown and collapsing — the dynasty's decay finally shows.

name: Plum
personality: Poised and sensual — a dusty bloom of untouchable class.

prime: Deep purple with a bloom — the sensual aristocrat everyone covets.
ripening: Wrinkling and splitting — the polished image cracks as affairs surface.
senescence: A prune — shriveled, sweetened by regret, clinging to former glamour.

name: Apricot
personality: Warm and gentle, forever overshadowed by the peach.
character: Small and tender; the perpetual 'understudy' beauty.
cheating: The overlooked one who cheats just to finally feel chosen.
properties: Tiny stone fruit; velvety; a very short season; bruises fast.
growth: Green and shy — the neglected younger sibling.
prime: Golden and soft — briefly radiant before anyone bothers to notice.
ripening: Wrinkles quickly — jealousy of the peach curdles into betrayal.
senescence: A dried apricot — chewy with old resentment, sweet but forgotten.

name: Kiwi
personality: Plain outside, dazzling inside — quietly ambitious.
character: A fuzzy brown coat hiding emerald brilliance and tiny sharp seeds.
cheating: The 'quiet one' whose secret double life stuns everyone.
properties: Fuzzy exterior; vivid green interior; tiny black seeds; tart.
growth: Small and hairy — dismissed, underestimated, quietly plotting.
prime: Cut open to reveal brilliance — the dark horse who shocks the room.
ripening: Over-soft and fermenting — the double life finally leaks out.
senescence: Collapsed and sour — brilliance wasted, seeds scattered.

name: Pomegranate
personality: Mysterious and magnetic — keeper of a hundred secrets.
character: A tough rind hiding hundreds of jeweled seeds, a lover for each.
cheating: Many simultaneous secret affairs, one seed at a time.
properties: Leathery rind; hundreds of arils; stains crimson; myth of the underworld.
growth: Hard and pale — a secretive, watchful girl.
prime: Ruby-packed and regal — the seductress who owns everyone's secrets.
ripening: Splitting open — the hundred secrets spill at once and chaos erupts.
senescence: Dried and rattling — hollow seeds, a queen of an empty court.

name: Coconut
personality: Gruff and guarded, unbreakable — the sweetest man you'll never reach.
character: Wooden armor over sweet milk; it takes a hammer to open him up.
cheating: Emotionally unavailable — 'cheats' by withholding, not by straying.
properties: Three 'eyes'; a hard husk; sweet water inside; floats away from problems.
growth: Green and full of water — a soft kid building his shell early.
prime: Hard brown and sealed — the stoic everyone respects and no one knows.
ripening: Cracks appear — the shell finally splits, too late for those who left.
senescence: A dried husk — hollow and rattling, the milk long gone.

name: Papaya
personality: Lush and tropical — unfamiliar and intoxicating.
character: Soft and seed-filled; an outsider who upends the social order.
cheating: The homewrecker newcomer nobody saw coming.
properties: Soft orange flesh; a cavity of black seeds; an enzyme that tenderizes (disarms).
growth: Green and firm — a stranger sizing up the new town.
prime: Ripe and fragrant — the exotic arrival who steals every heart.
ripening: Mushy and fermenting — the town turns on the outsider.
senescence: Collapsed and sour — run out on a rail, seeds scattered behind her.

name: Passionfruit
personality: All-consuming passion; wrinkled outside, wild inside.
character: A plain, even ugly shell hiding a riot of seeds and pulp.
cheating: The whirlwind affair that burns everything down.
properties: Wrinkled purple shell; tart seedy pulp; heady aroma; short-lived intensity.
growth: Smooth and green — a quiet romantic waiting to erupt.
prime: Wrinkled but ripe — the intense lover who consumes her partners.
ripening: Shrivels fast — the passion curdles into obsession.
senescence: A hollow husk — burnt out, with nothing left to give.

name: Dragonfruit
personality: A stunning exterior with shockingly bland substance.
character: Flamboyant pink scales; pays in aesthetics, never in depth.
cheating: Cheats for clout — trades partners for a better 'look'.
properties: Vivid pink-and-green scales; mild seedy flesh; more photo than flavor.
growth: Green and closed — an insecure kid obsessed with image.
prime: Dazzling and viral — the influencer everyone follows and no one knows.
ripening: Colors dull and flesh browns — the shallow act stops working.
senescence: Mushy and gray — unfollowed and empty behind the filter.

name: Lychee
personality: Sweet, fragrant, fragile — precious, and she knows it.
character: A rough red shell, translucent tender flesh, a hard secret pit.
cheating: The pampered darling who strays purely out of boredom.
properties: Bumpy red rind; perfumed white flesh; a single dark seed; spoils fast.
growth: Green and hard — a sheltered, coddled girl.
prime: Blushing and fragrant — the ingénue everyone adores.
ripening: Browns within hours — spoiled and demanding; adorers flee.
senescence: Shrunken and brown — a faded darling nobody pampers now.

name: Fig
personality: Demure and ancient, hiding something literally inside her.
character: Soft and sweet, but a secret (the wasp) lives at her core.
cheating: Harbors a hidden partner nobody knows exists — for years.
properties: Soft skin; jammy interior; a pollinator wasp within; the fig leaf that hides shame.
growth: Hard and green — a modest girl with a buried secret.
prime: Plump and honeyed — the demure sweetheart with a hidden life.
ripening: Splits open and oozes — the secret crawls out into scandal.
senescence: A dried fig — wrinkled and preserved, still hiding the old wasp.

name: Date
personality: Honeyed charm and old-world wisdom, wrinkled by experience.
character: Sticky-sweet words over a hard pit of stubbornness.
cheating: The charming patriarch with a 'second family' in another oasis.
properties: Wrinkled and dark; intensely sweet; a single hard pit; keeps for years.
growth: Green and astringent — an ambitious desert youth.
prime: Amber and honey-sweet — the beloved elder everyone quotes.
ripening: Wrinkles deepen — the second life is discovered.
senescence: Dried and sugar-crusted — a sweet legend, hollow at the pit.

name: Guava
personality: Intensely aromatic and unpredictable — love-him-or-hate-him.
character: Perfumes the whole room; full of gritty little seeds (grudges).
cheating: Impulsive flings driven by intense whims.
properties: A powerful aroma; gritty seeds; green-to-pink; ripens unevenly.
growth: Hard and green — a restless, pungent youngster.
prime: Fragrant and ripe — the wildcard who fills every room.
ripening: Overpowering and bruised — the intensity becomes too much.
senescence: Fermented and cloying — a scent that outstayed its welcome.

name: Cantaloupe
personality: Warm and sweet, a little bland — desperate to be liked.
character: A rough netted skin over soft fragrant flesh; forgettable unless fresh.
cheating: The people-pleaser who says yes to everyone, including the wrong one.
properties: Netted rind; orange musky flesh; a seedy cavity; a very short peak.
growth: Hard and green — an eager-to-please wallflower.
prime: Fragrant and sweet — briefly the belle of the fruit bowl.
ripening: Softening and musky — the neediness sours friendships.
senescence: Collapsed and reeking — overripe and avoided by all.

name: Honeydew
personality: Smooth, pale, serene — coolly detached.
character: Flawless green skin; refreshing but reserved; hard to warm up.
cheating: The cold affair of convenience — no heat, all strategy.
properties: Smooth pale rind; pale green flesh; a subtle sweetness; keeps well.
growth: Hard and white — a distant, guarded girl.
prime: Cool and flawless — the serene beauty everyone chases.
ripening: Softening and sticky — the ice cracks and the strategy is exposed.
senescence: Sunken and fermented — her coldness leaves her utterly alone.

name: Grapefruit
personality: Bittersweet, elegant, cuttingly intelligent.
character: Pretty pink flesh with a mouth-puckering bite; refined and a little cruel.
cheating: The intellectual affair — seduces minds and breaks hearts coldly.
properties: Bitter-tart; pink flesh; thick pith; interacts badly with everything.
growth: Green and harsh — a sharp, prickly overachiever.
prime: Blushing and bitter-sweet — the sophisticate who out-talks everyone.
ripening: Pith thickens and juice dries — the cruelty isolates her.
senescence: Dry and bitter — brilliant, respected, and utterly alone.

name: Tangerine
personality: Effortless and breezy — everyone's low-effort favorite.

cheating: An accidental serial flirt who charms without meaning to and hurts anyway.
properties: A loose easy peel; sweet segments; small; seedless (leaves nothing behind).
growth: Green and tart — a friendly, unremarkable kid.
prime: Bright and easy — the effortless charmer everyone likes.
ripening: Peel dries and segments separate — the easy charm reads as careless.
senescence: Dry and hollow — likable to the end and loved by none.

name: Nectarine
personality: Smooth and confident — the 'new and improved' beauty.

cheating: Steals partners just to prove she's the upgrade.
properties: Smooth skin; firm sweet flesh; a hard stone; a rivalry with the peach.
growth: Green and hard — a competitive, envious youth.
prime: Glossy and firm — the sleek rival stealing the peach's spotlight.
ripening: Bruises and softens — the rivalry consumes her.
senescence: Wrinkled around the stone — a winner of nothing, alone with her pit.

name: Persimmon
personality: Looks ripe and sweet, but is brutally astringent if you rush her.

cheating: Lures a partner in, then turns cold and 'astringent'.

growth: Hard and mouth-drying — a guarded, punishing girl.
prime: Glowing orange and honey-sweet — irresistible once she's finally ready.
ripening: Jelly-soft — the sweetness slips into collapse.
senescence: Blackened jelly — a beauty that spoiled into bitterness.

name: Cranberry
personality: Sharp and seasonal — festive but severe.
character: Bounces when fresh, bursts when pushed; sour without lots of sugar (money).
cheating: The holiday affair — appears once a year, causes chaos, then vanishes.
properties: Bounces when firm; very tart; grows in bogs; only sweet with heaps of sugar.
growth: White and hard — a severe, disapproving youth.
prime: Deep red and bouncing — the tart matriarch of every holiday.
ripening: Softening and bursting — the sourness drives the family away.
senescence: Mushy in the bog — sour, seasonal, forgotten out of season.

name: Mango
personality: Lush, generous, larger-than-life — the 'king of fruits'.
character: Messy and juicy, impossible to eat cleanly; love is chaos with him.
cheating: Grand passionate affairs he swears are 'true love' every single time.
properties: Juicy; a huge flat stone; fibrous; stains and drips; tropical royalty.
growth: Green and sour — a hungry, ambitious prince.
prime: Golden and dripping — the passionate king everyone orbits.
ripening: Overripe and fermenting — his passions collide and combust.
senescence: Stringy and sunken — a fallen king clutching the stone of past glory.

name: Jackfruit
personality: Huge and intimidating — secretly the softest and most generous.

cheating: Too loyal to cheat — betrayed BY others and blamed for their sins.

growth: Small and spiky — a gentle giant-in-waiting, teased for his size.
prime: Massive and generous — feeds everyone and asks for nothing.
ripening: Overripe and sticky — his generosity is exploited; friends betray him.
senescence: Fermented and split — used up and hollowed, blamed for others' rot.

name: Durian
personality: Divisive and proud — 'king' to some, banned by the rest.
character: A foul aroma and formidable spikes over a custard heart a loyal few adore.
cheating: Doesn't chase; he's the forbidden one others secretly crave and deny.

growth: Small and green — an odd, off-putting kid pushed to the edges.
prime: Pungent and formidable — the pariah king with a cult following.
ripening: The reek intensifies — even loyalists can't defend him; cast out.
senescence: Rotten and cracked — a legend whispered about but never invited.

name: Rambutan
personality: Flamboyant, hairy, a chaotic-good weirdo.

cheating: Chaotic flings; loyal in heart, careless in body.
properties: A red hairy shell; translucent sweet flesh; a clingy seed; exotic.

prime: Wild-red and sweet — the beloved weirdo everyone's fascinated by.

senescence: Dried and spiky — a strange relic, fondly forgotten.

name: Mangosteen
personality: Regal and serene, quietly supreme — the 'queen of fruits'.

cheating: Too proud to cheat openly — the cold betrayal of withdrawal.

growth: Green and hard — a poised, sheltered princess.
prime: Deep purple and pristine — the serene queen everyone reveres.

senescence: Woody and sour — a dethroned queen in a purple ruin.

name: Custard Apple
personality: Gentle and sweet, a little spaced-out — a heart of custard.

cheating: Drifts into an affair while 'not really paying attention'.

character: Rows of perfect kernel-teeth; a husk hiding something; 'children of the corn'.
cheating: The squeaky-clean one whose double life turns out to be the darkest.
properties: Husk and silk (hides things); rows of kernels; pops under heat; field-grown.
growth: Green-husked and small — a naive, wholesome farm kid.
prime: Golden and full — the all-American darling everyone trusts.
ripening: Kernels dent and dry — the wholesome mask cracks into something eerie.
senescence: Dried on the cob — a hollow husk with a chilling secret.

name: Bell Pepper
personality: Changes color with the crowd; sweet, agreeable, spineless.
character: Comes in every color; hollow inside; mirrors whoever he's with.
cheating: Becomes whatever each partner wants — cheats by being everyone's ideal.
properties: Hollow; multi-colored (green to red as it ripens); sweet; crunchy.
growth: Green and firm — an unformed people-pleaser.
prime: Vivid red or yellow — the charming chameleon everyone thinks is 'for them'.
ripening: Wrinkling — the shape-shifting is exposed as emptiness.
senescence: Collapsed and hollow — no self left, abandoned by all his 'versions'.

name: Chili Pepper
personality: Fiery and addictive — dangerous to get close to.
character: Small and intense; leaves a burn nobody forgets.
cheating: The passionate, explosive affair that scorches everyone involved.
properties: Capsaicin heat; small but intense; addictive; the redder the hotter.
growth: Green and mild — a simmering, underestimated kid.
prime: Red and blazing — the firebrand everyone's drawn to and burned by.
ripening: Drying and wrinkling — the heat turns destructive.
senescence: Dried and brittle — a burnt-out flame, all past scandal.

name: Carrot
personality: Down-to-earth and hardworking, hiding his brightness underground.
character: Buried achievements; a sharp point; 'dangles the carrot' of promises.
cheating: The ambitious climber who dangles love as a reward, then withholds it.
properties: Grows unseen underground; bright when pulled; sharpens eyesight (sees all); crunchy.
growth: Thin and pale — a buried, overlooked grinder.
prime: Bright orange and firm — the striver whose success finally shows.
ripening: Going limp and woody — the dangled promises are exposed as empty.
senescence: Rubbery and sprouting — a used-up hustler nobody believes anymore.

name: Pumpkin
personality: Grand and warm, magical for one season — then discarded.
character: Cinderella's carriage; a huge heart full of seeds; a pre-midnight star.
cheating: The whirlwind seasonal romance she knows will 'turn back into a pumpkin'.
properties: Huge; hollow with seeds; carriage and lantern symbolism; one glorious season.
growth: Small and green — a hopeful girl waiting for her season.
prime: Enormous and glowing — the seasonal queen everyone celebrates.
ripening: Caving in — midnight strikes and the magic (and the lovers) vanish.
senescence: Collapsed and moldy — a rotting lantern nobody remembers by winter.

name: Avocado
personality: Rich and soft-hearted — ripe for exactly five minutes.
character: One enormous pit (a heart); perfect briefly; 'basic' but beloved.
cheating: Falls hard and fast for the wrong one during his tiny window.
properties: A single huge pit; buttery flesh; ripe for minutes then brown; painfully trendy.
growth: Hard and green — a guarded, not-ready romantic.
prime: Perfectly ripe — irresistible for one glorious, doomed moment.
ripening: Browning fast — the window slams and the love spoils overnight.
senescence: Stringy and black — a big heart turned bitter around the stone.

name: Star Fruit
personality: Wants to be the star of every scene; all angles, thin substance.
character: Cut into perfect stars; a beautiful shape and a mild flavor; always performing.
cheating: Cheats for attention and applause, never for love.
properties: Star-shaped slices; waxy; mildly sweet-sour; more looks than taste.
growth: Green and edged — an attention-starved kid.
prime: Golden stars — the show-stealer everyone photographs.
ripening: Browning edges — the act wears thin and audiences leave.
senescence: Shriveled points — a faded star performing to an empty room.

name: Cucumber
personality: Unshakeably cool and mild — 'cool as a cucumber', maybe too detached.
character: Long, cool, watery; hard to ruffle; hides indifference as calm.
cheating: The cold, low-effort affair — never invested enough to care.
properties: Mostly water; a cool interior; mild; refreshing but bland.
growth: Small and bitter-ended — a detached, aloof youth.
prime: Long and cool — the unflappable customer everyone leans on.
ripening: Yellowing and softening — the coolness reads as never caring.
senescence: Mushy and hollow — cold to the end, mourned by none.

name: Gooseberry
personality: Tart and striped — forever the 'gooseberry', the unwanted third.
character: Translucent striped skin; sour; hovers at the edge of every couple.
cheating: The third wheel who finally breaks up the couple she envied.
properties: Translucent veined skin; very tart; hairy on some types; an edge-dweller.
growth: Hard and green — an excluded, envious girl.
prime: Plump and striped — the third wheel who becomes the temptation.
ripening: Splitting — the envy-driven scheme detonates.
senescence: Shriveled — bitter and sidelined again, permanently.

name: Redcurrant
personality: Tiny and tart, thriving in clusters of chatter.
character: Strings of jewel beads; spreads sour rumors down the whole bunch.
cheating: The gossip whose 'harmless' whispers cause everyone else's affairs.
properties: Tiny translucent beads on strings; very tart; ornamental; clustered.
growth: Green and hard — a small, whispering hanger-on.
prime: Glowing red strings — the gossip wired into everyone's business.
ripening: Dropping off the string — the rumors rebound on her.
senescence: Shriveled beads — a spent gossip nobody listens to.

name: Mulberry
personality: Sweet and generous, but leaves a permanent mark on everyone.
character: Deep-staining juice; can't touch a life without leaving evidence.
cheating: Leaves undeniable 'stains' (evidence) everywhere he strays.
properties: Deep purple; stains hands and pavement; messy; fast-spoiling.
growth: Red and tart — a messy, careless youth.
prime: Dark and sweet — generous but marks everyone he loves.
ripening: Bleeding juice — the evidence of his affairs is suddenly everywhere.
senescence: Squashed and staining — undone by the marks he couldn't hide.

name: Prickly Pear
personality: Armored and resilient — sweet only to the patient and careful.
character: Fine invisible spines (glochids) that stick to anyone who grabs too fast.
cheating: Hurts partners 'by accident' with defenses she refuses to lower.
properties: Hidden glochids; magenta flesh; desert-tough; sweet if handled right.
growth: Spiny and hard — a defensive, wounded youth.
prime: Magenta and sweet — a resilient beauty for the careful few.
ripening: Drying — the defenses drive off even the patient ones.
senescence: A withered pad — armored, sweet, and utterly alone.

name: Plantain
personality: Stern and practical — 'you can't eat me raw', no-nonsense.
character: Banana's tougher brother; needs cooking (effort); a provider, not a charmer.
cheating: The dutiful provider whose one lapse shatters his stern image.
properties: Starchy; inedible raw; must be cooked; sturdier than a banana.
growth: Green and hard — a serious, responsible eldest.
prime: Firm and starchy — the reliable provider everyone leans on.
ripening: Blackening skin — the one secret lapse cracks his rigid image.
senescence: Black and soft — a fallen patriarch, sweeter but broken.

name: Ugli Fruit
personality: Homely outside, gorgeous within — with a chip on the shoulder.
character: A wrinkled, blotchy rind hiding fruit sweeter than anything; underestimated always.
cheating: The underdog who 'wins' a partner just to spite the beautiful ones.
properties: A wrinkled ugly rind; extremely sweet juicy flesh; a citrus hybrid.
growth: Green and lumpy — a mocked, resentful kid.
prime: Homely but honeyed — the underdog who wins hearts by surprise.
ripening: The rind roughens — the chip on the shoulder sabotages love.
senescence: Dry and blotchy — bitter that beauty always got there first.
